subtitle: 짐 분실 · 문장별 음성 재생
desc: 수하물이 안 나왔을 때 신고할 때

tips.en: When can I get it back?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: My suitcase didn't come out. I think it's missing.
turns.ko: 캐리어이 안 나왔어요. 분실된 것 같아요.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: May I see your baggage claim tag?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Yes. Here it is. It was a black suitcase.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: Let me check. I'm sorry. It may be on the next flight.
turns.ko: 확인해 볼게요. 죄송합니다. 다음 편에 있을 수 있습니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: When can I get it back?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: We'll deliver it to your hotel as soon as it arrives.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Could you write down the tracking number, please?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: Of course. Please fill out this form.
